title: I Built a $30k/mo App That Helps You Quit Smoking
description:
I Built a $30k/mo App That Helps You Quit Smoking
Start building & deploying paywalls in 10 minutes flat: https://superwall.com/

Join a community of world class consumer app founders and growth hackers: https://joinconsumerclub.com/

Two founders, Asher and Thatcher, share how they built a $30k/month app that helps people quit smoking. In this podcast, they break down their full app development process — from first idea to profitable launch — and explain how their app is helping people stop smoking and take back control of their health.

They talk through everything from the mindset behind how to quit smoking and how to quit smoking easily, to the challenges of quitting smoking and building a product that actually makes a difference. You’ll hear how they navigated mobile app development, outlined their app development roadmap, and used skills in coding, programming, and software development to bring it all together.

This is also a real-world example of app development for beginners, with insights on how to develop an app, create an app, and make an app even without a massive team. They also get into how the business model works, how they validated their app ideas, and what it takes to turn new business ideas into best business ideas that grow.

If you're a software developer, diving into full stack development, or just looking for smart business ideas, this episode is full of lessons, wins, and practical takeaways.
